citations.assessment: Sherira names Huna son of Mar Zutra as exilarch; Zutra is bracketed at the first occurrence and spelled out at the second. The terse Heilprin list supplies no specific identity beyond the name.
Rav Ashi reports a warning on witnesses from Natan son of Mar Zutra. The separate Heilprin entry cites the same passage.
